title: A new student's health
body: A Grade 8 student moved with his family to a new school in another city. He had no friends there, and both his parents were busy with work, so he felt lonely. To cope, he started spending several hours every day on his phone and on social media, but he only felt worse. He stopped trying to talk to classmates, began to get frequent headaches, lost weight and could not sleep well at night. A doctor examined him and advised him to cut down his screen time and to meet the school counsellor. The counsellor arranged activities and group work that helped him make friends, and over the next few months his sleep, appetite and mood improved.

title: Dengue cases in a hospital
body: A hospital recorded the number of dengue cases it treated in each month of one year: January 10, February 12, March 15, April 18, May 22, June 40, July 65, August 65, September 65, October 30, November 30 and December 20. Dengue is caused by a virus and is spread by mosquitos, which breed in still water such as water collected in coolers, tyres, pots and open containers. Health workers noted that the number of cases rose sharply soon after the arrival of the monsoon.
